items.text: AMEND AND RECOMMIT TO LOCAL GOVERNMENT

items.actClause: AN ACT to amend section 1 of chapter 924 of the laws of 1941 relating to legalizing acts and proceedings of the town board of the town of Southold, Suffolk county relating to the establishment of the Mattituck park district, in relation to appointment of a treasurer by the park commissioners
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S5776

 PURPOSE :

To provide for the appointment of the treasurer of the Mattituck Park
District.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :

This bill amends section one of Chapter 925 of the Laws of 1941 which
created the Mattituck park District in the town of Southold, Suffolk
County, by providing for an appointed rather than elected treasurer of
the district. The park commissioners would appoint the treasurer.

 JUSTIFICATION :

The original park district, established in 1941,provided for an
elected treasurer who had to be a resident of the district. In recent
years, the annual budget of the district has grown to over one half
million dollars. The size of the budget and the complexity of the
accounting, bookkeeping and auditing requirements now attendant to
such a position requires the knowledge and expertise of a trained
financial professional. By enacting this change, which has been
endorsed by unanimous resolution of the board of commissioners, the
district will have the ability to employ an individual who possesses
those required skills and not be restrained by the territorial
boundaries of the district.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

New bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

None to the State

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.

summary: Provides that the treasurer for the Mattituck park district shall be appointed by the park commissioners rather than elected by the residents of such district; abolishes the three-year term limit for such treasurer.
